existing_row_decisions.reason: The existing row concerns asymptotic LOCC dense coding for the symmetric four-qubit W state, whereas the candidate proves a graded Kirillov–Reshetikhin extension/R-matrix identity in representation theory. The Cao surname is a credited decomposition lead in the old row; the questions, theorem objects and publications differ.

The old result is isolated Harnack/Martin-kernel contact in an annulus; the candidate is a ratio-free restricted-sumset counterexample over integers. Green occurs in the old phrase Green line and does not make it the Green–Kane publication.

The old result concerns metric Gromov–Hausdorff/GIT cubic compactifications and Cartier-index rigidity. The candidate is Laurent coefficient positivity of rank-two quantum greedy elements under divisibility. Li is only a broad surname/credit overlap.

The existing theorem constructs a rank-two entropy-minimizing Fano degeneration; the candidate proves divisibility-case positivity in quantum cluster algebras. Neither rank-two terminology nor a Li credit identifies the mathematical statement.
